subject: link onclick javascript update, does not induce reactivity

messages.author: d334869cda817467
messages.subject: link onclick javascript update, does not induce reactivity
parts:
I am displaying a data table and one of the fields is populated strings wrapped in <a></a> tags.

I have the following onclick property defined within the <a> tag - one of these links looks something like this:

<a href="#" onclick="javascript:document.getElementById(\'a_text_input_id\').value=\'', myValue, '\'">some text</a>

Inside of server.R, I have an observer that watches 'a_text_input_id' and does some action. The reactivity is not triggered when the link is clicked, which does update the 'a_text_input_id' textInput() field, but when I update the field manually (typing myself) the app does respond. I can see the 'a_text_input_id' textInput() filed updating with the myValue value, but for whatever reason this is not triggering the expected reactive behavior. I have also confirmed that I can trigger the expected reactive behavior by typing into the 'a_text_input_field' textInput() field manually.

Not sure what the problem is here. If I had to guess, I'd suppose my javascript skills are lacking and there is a better way I can update the 'a_text_input_field' testInput() field when the link is clicked, in order to trigger the expected reactive behavior.

Any ideas?

messages.subject: Re: link onclick javascript update, does not induce reactivity
parts:
Here's an example of the onclick problem I'm having updating a textInput that is not then triggering reactivity related to the textInput...


in ui.R file,

HTML('<a href="#" onclick="javascript:document.getElementById(\'a_text_input_id\').value=\'myValue\'">update text input with "myValue"</a>'),
textInput("a_text_input_id", "")


in server.R file,

observe(print(input$a_text_input_id))


... the 'a_text_input_id' field is updated onclick (good), but the observer is not triggered (why?). Modify 'a_text_input_id' manually and the observer is triggered.


- Dan

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: link onclick javascript update, does not induce reactivity
parts:
Setting its value is not enough. You have to trigger the change event,
e.g. with jQuery, you can do
$('input#a_text_input_field').val(myValue).change().

Regards,
Yihui

not sure if my reply went through, so here it is again:

hmmm... it's not working for whatever reason. Helpful to hear, "it ought to work", so I'll keep trying to see what the issue is. That said, I tried a barebones example:

# ui.R

HTML('<a href="#input_panel" onclick="$(\'input#input_id\').val(526).change()">clickme</a>'),
textInput('input_id', '')

# server.R

observe(print(input$input_id))

and it worked. I'm just confused I guess. I'll figure this out.

The reason I'm doing this is that I present a datatable with some links I generate on the fly. Each link relates to a particular ID number, so when a link is clicked I populated the text field with the ID number associated with that link, and then server-side logic is meant to observe the updated text field (with the ID in it) and populated another datatable with data regarding that ID. Is there a better practice for doing this?

Thanks again,
Dan
